name: dw
description: Compose MiniMax H3 video, MiniMax Music 3, LTX-2.5, Kandinsky 6.0 and FLUX 3 Klein workflows over a dw MCP server, cut a multi-episode series from them, direct camera and look in each family's caption format, storyboard a scene before it is filmed, and plan a piece longer than one clip from measured levers: which template fits which shape, the hard rules, cost, and how to judge the output. Prompt format comes from the vendors' own guides.
